evidence_description: Establishes coding standards, simulation bundling rules, dosimetry constraints, and daily treatment verification CPT edits.
Prior authorization checklist collecting TNM stage, lumpectomy/mastectomy margins, nodal status, receptor status, and hypofractionation eligibility for breast radiation.
Checklist capturing baseline PSA, Gleason score, clinical T stage, NCCN risk category, and ADT therapy for definitive/adjuvant prostate radiation.
Checklist collecting histology, TNM stage, pulmonary function (FEV1/DLCO), medically inoperable status, and SBRT eligibility for non-small cell lung cancer.
Checklist capturing brain/spine histology, WHO grade, surgical resection extent, KPS score, and SRS/SRT vs IMRT/Proton beam qualification.
Checklist capturing rectal cancer distance from anal verge, clinical T/N stage, neoadjuvant chemoradiation vs short-course radiation, and surgical plan.
Checklist capturing primary site, HPV/p16 status, nodal involvement, critical organ sparing (parotids, optic chiasm, brainstem), and IMRT medical necessity.
